basis: Thalamic neuronal injury defines disease. Arrhythmia is reported in 30-79%, but intrinsic or sustained cardiac injury is unestablished; respiratory insufficiency does not establish lung damage.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: arrhythmia occurs in 30-79%, but the record does not establish direct cardiac damage or persistent cardiac dysfunction.

basis: Malignant neuroendocrine tumor arising in autonomic jugulotympanic paraganglia. Vascular proximity is not vascular origin; metastatic organ sites are unspecified.

decisions.neurologic: primary: origin in peripheral autonomic paraganglia supports the neural axis. [Anatomy](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2837305/)

basis: Renal concentrating failure and cerebral dysfunction define syndrome; dental damage and joint restriction occur in 80-99%. Hearing loss (30-79%) is omitted under the four-axis cap.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: joint restriction occurs in 80-99%, with skeletal hypoplasia; prioritized over less frequent hearing impairment.
decisions.otologic: none under cap: conductive hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%, below the frequency of retained dental and musculoskeletal damage.

basis: Chronic hepatic failure commonly (>30%) impairs coagulation-factor synthesis and coagulation function. Encephalopathy and hepatorenal syndrome are separate diagnoses.

decisions.haematologic: involved: intrinsic impairment of clotting-factor synthesis causes coagulation dysfunction in well over 30% of patients with established chronic liver failure.

basis: Marrow failure defines syndrome; hypogonadism with elevated FSH occurs in 2/2 and Chiari I malformation in 1/2 (50%). Frequencies derive from only two reported patients.

decisions.neurologic: involved: Chiari I malformation is structural CNS involvement in 1/2 patients (50%); the tiny reported series limits confidence.

basis: Craniofacial/limb dysostosis, microcephaly and frequent dental caries are defining features; intellectual disability and dental abnormalities occur in 80-99%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: frequent caries are explicitly part of the defining phenotype; dental and palatal abnormalities occur in 80-99%.
decisions.neurologic: primary: defining microcephaly, the intellectual-disability parent and intellectual disability in 80-99% establish a neurodevelopmental component.

basis: ZIC2 forebrain malformation; endocrine involvement is inferred from hypothalamic dysfunction causing central DI in ~70% of classic HPE, with subtype-specific frequency uncertain.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: inferred from central DI in ~70% of classic HPE; ZIC2-specific frequency is uncertain. [Cohort](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16355806/)

basis: Progressive encephalopathy with edema/leukoencephalopathy defines PEBEL; both subtypes are inborn disorders of NAD(P)HX metabolite repair.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: PEBEL1 and PEBEL2 are NAD(P)HX metabolite-repair deficiencies, establishing a metabolic mechanism. [Study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12910793/)

basis: Glycosylation-related dystrophy; neurologic dysfunction spans severe and mild forms (ID in 3/3 reported mild cases). Ocular damage is subtype-dependent; pooled frequency is uncertain.

decisions.neurologic: involved: CNS dysfunction spans severe and mild phenotypes; intellectual disability affected 3/3 mild cases. [Report](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8728375/)
decisions.ocular: none: eye malformations characterize severe type A8 but are absent in reported milder forms; a qualifying frequency across the umbrella is not established.

basis: Neuropathy with defining laryngeal dysfunction and hearing loss; muscle atrophy occurs in 39/42 (93%) and scoliosis in 26/40 (65%). Vocal paresis is 11/42 but is a defining feature.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: the definition specifically identifies vocal-cord anomalies and respiratory impairment; laryngeal loss of function is defining despite paresis in 11/42.
decisions.otologic: primary: sensorineural hearing loss is explicitly a defining component of this CMT subtype; HPO provides no separate frequency estimate.
